# Gregory Stevenson - Pacific Ridgeway

> Education-first retirement income, indexed annuity, and legacy planning for families. Led by Gregory Stevenson - U.S. Navy veteran, Founder & CEO of Pacific Ridgeway, and author of "Indexed Annuity Secrets."

Gregory Stevenson helps families near or in retirement protect their savings from market losses, create dependable lifetime income, and build a lasting legacy. The approach is education-first: clear, jargon-free guidance with no pressure. Services include retirement income planning, indexed annuities, life insurance, legacy planning, tax-efficient strategies, and asset protection. Pacific Ridgeway is a DBA of Horizon Inc. All content is for general education and is not financial, tax, or legal advice.

## Learn (educational articles)
- [What Is an Indexed Annuity?](https://gregorystevensonfinancial.com/learn/what-is-an-indexed-annuity/): How indexed annuities grow with a market index while protecting principal from losses.
- [Can You Lose Money in an Indexed Annuity?](https://gregorystevensonfinancial.com/learn/can-you-lose-money-in-an-indexed-annuity/): Principal is protected from market drops; fees, surrender charges, and withdrawals explained.
- [Annuity vs. 401(k)](https://gregorystevensonfinancial.com/learn/annuity-vs-401k/): How the two differ and why many retirees use both.
- [Learning Center](https://gregorystevensonfinancial.com/learn/): All articles on annuities and retirement income.
